decision: retain checked KiCad rule export and structural merge repair
scope: Five source/test files over admitted checked-scientific production. Pre-existing native geometry work is preserved and separately checked for compatibility; it is not admitted by this change. All 39 properties, 14 targets, and crate future work remain in scope.
api_change: rules_to_kicad_dru and merge_rules_into_kicad_dru now return Result<String, KicadDruError>. Callers must propagate or handle failure. The CLI completes rendering before calling fs::write; conversion/merge failures preserve an existing destination, including in-place merge input/output.

numeric_contract.units: fixed decimal millimeters on a one-nanometer grid
numeric_contract.nonpositive: omit only after a certified nonpositive enclosure

merge_contract: Preserve bytes outside owned spans; replace marked blocks and exactly six reserved rule names; understand hash comments, single/double quotes and escaped quotes; migrate only recognized legacy semicolon comments. Add a missing version header. Reject unbalanced lists/strings, malformed/duplicate/misplaced version headers, unknown semicolon comments, and nested/unmatched/misplaced generated markers. Repeated merges are byte-identical. This is structural validation, not full semantic validation of arbitrary custom rules.

validation.strict_clippy: release, all features, all targets, -D warnings

repaired_observations: Scientific exponent zero trimming no longer corrupts thresholds. Tiny and oversized values return typed errors.
Original unresolved zero and unresolved halfway cases return Uncertified within the finite search; final-value abort returns Aborted.
Generated and merged decks use KiCad hash comments and one version header.
Same-line custom rules and rules following parentheses inside comments survive merging.
Unterminated generated blocks fail without discarding content or overwriting the CLI destination.
Installed KiCad flags tracks one nanometer below the emitted limit and accepts tracks at and above it, including a rounded halfway threshold.

preserved_preflight_history.status: source snapshot only; not compiled or validated
preserved_preflight_history.correction: Widen i32::MAX to the i64 numerator accepted by Rational::fraction before compilation. v1 input copies preserve the superseded source; its former working directory now contains v2.
Increase the integration test raw-string delimiter so a quoted marker does not terminate the Rust literal.
Exempt exact raw .kicad_dru output from EOF whitespace normalization.

cost_scope: Correctness and boundary-contract repair. Existing full-board test gates pass in production. Command durations and binary/library sizes are retained as observations; no matched throughput, allocation, or size optimization claim is made.
limitations: Underlying approximation work is not given a total-work or wall-time bound by the adapter precision floor.
KiCad consumer fixtures validate track-width enforcement; the semantics of the other exported constraints are not comprehensively audited.
Arbitrary existing custom-rule semantics and rule-priority interactions are not validated by the structural merge scanner.
The public return-type change requires caller migration.
The pre-existing native geometry prototype remains unadmitted; its failing performance gate was not rerun or waived.
No full workspace pre-push workflow matrix, CI change, push, publication, or deployment is included.

primary_references.supports: Version header, hash comments, custom-rule grammar.
PCB coordinate internal unit of one nanometer; distinguish board serialization from rule-expression parsing.
Rule constraint min/max/opt use integer values from the expression evaluator.
Expression result converted by KiROUND; millimeter, mil and inch unit resolution.
